svg.title: The Carving: Scrimshaw
svg.desc: The Carving (1D): a bone blank on a slab, engraved like scrimshaw in black lines on ivory. The faint dotted outline of a hook lies over the blank; the chisel drags a straight stroke along the grain, and a knot sits in the way where a cross-grain cut would split it. On the left a row of notches counts the strokes left under the recipient's mark; on the right a lamp burns down.
